subject.title: fix: filter out transport from stream override check to unblock Codex WS transport

question: May this external transport-fix branch modify or remove OpenClaw's CODEOWNERS, security workflows, release automation, and ClawHub dependency graph?
rationale: Those changes cross protected security and supply-chain boundaries and cannot be accepted or waived by automated review, even though they appear unrelated to the stated fix.

options.title: Require a narrow replacement
options.body: Close or supersede this head and request a fresh PR containing only the correctly layered transport fix, focused tests, and real route proof.

options.title: Restore and rework this branch
options.body: Require the contributor to restore every unrelated `.github` and dependency change, preserve authored override classification, and rebuild the fix in the OpenClaw transport path.

options.title: Authorize the infrastructure changes
options.body: A security owner may explicitly authorize and separately review the `.github` and dependency scope if those changes were genuinely intentional.

recommendation.title: Require a narrow replacement
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this head and request a fresh PR containing only the correctly layered transport fix, focused tests, and real route proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The transport policy history makes this the best available owner for confirming the runtime boundary, with security owners separately required for the `.github` scope.
